lede: Kaizen Motors is a car workshop at Ark@KB, 68 Kaki Bukit Avenue 6. Its website lists maintenance and repairs, inspections, computer diagnostics, accident repair and spray painting, for private cars and company vehicles.
good_for: Buyers who want a car checked before purchase
faqs: Its website lists preventive and corrective maintenance, pre-LTA and pre-purchase inspections, computer diagnostics, accident repair and claims, spray painting, and tyres and alignment.
Which vehicles does Kaizen Motors work on?
Its website says Japanese, Korean and Continental vehicles, and also vans, lorries and company vehicles.
Can I get a car inspected before buying?
Pre-purchase inspection is listed on its website. Ask the workshop how to book.
Does Kaizen Motors handle accident repairs?
Accident repair and claims, and spray painting, are listed on its website.
Please see Google Maps for current hours.
